```{r, include=FALSE}

#all of this set of blocks until the break is just to import YouTube data

url = "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/"

```
```{r, include=FALSE}
api_params = 
  paste(paste0("key=", key), 
        paste0("id=", id), 
        "part=snippet,contentDetails,statistics",
        sep = "&")
api_call <- paste0(url, "channels", "?", api_params)
api_result <- GET(api_call)
json_result <- content(api_result, "text", encoding="UTF-8")

channel.json <- fromJSON(json_result, flatten = T)
channel.df <- as.data.frame(channel.json)
```
```{r, include=FALSE}
api_params <- paste0("part=snippet,contentDetails,statistics&id=", id, "&key=", key)
api_call <- paste0(url, "channels?", api_params)

api_result <- GET(api_call)
json_result <- content(api_result, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
channel.json <- fromJSON(json_result, flatten = TRUE)

channel.df <- as.data.frame(channel.json$items)
all_videos <- channel.df$contentDetails.relatedPlaylists.uploads
```
```{r, include=FALSE}
all_videos <- channel.df$contentDetails.relatedPlaylists.uploads

nextPageToken <- ""
upload.df <- NULL
pageInfo <- NULL

while (!is.null(nextPageToken)) {
  
  api_params <- 
    paste(paste0("key=", key), 
          paste0("playlistId=", all_videos), 
          "part=snippet,contentDetails,status",
          "maxResults=50",
          sep = "&")
  
  if (nextPageToken != "") {
    api_params <- paste0(api_params,
                         "&pageToken=",nextPageToken)
  }
  
  api_call <- paste0(url, "playlistItems", "?", api_params)
  api_result <- GET(api_call)
  json_result <- content(api_result, "text", encoding="UTF-8")
  upload.json <- fromJSON(json_result, flatten = T)
  
  nextPageToken <- upload.json$nextPageToken
  pageInfo <- upload.json$pageInfo
  
  curr.df <- as.data.frame(upload.json$items)
  if (is.null(upload.df)) {
    upload.df <- curr.df
  } else {
    upload.df <- bind_rows(upload.df, curr.df)
  }
}
```
```{r,include=FALSE}
video.df<- NULL

for (i in 1:nrow(upload.df)) {
  
  video_id <- upload.df$contentDetails.videoId[i]
  api_params <- 
    paste(paste0("key=", key), 
          paste0("id=", video_id), 
          "part=id,statistics,contentDetails",
          sep = "&")
  
  api_call <- paste0(url, "videos", "?", api_params)
  api_result <- GET(api_call)
  json_result <- content(api_result, "text", encoding="UTF-8")
  video.json <- fromJSON(json_result, flatten = T)
  
  curr.df <- as.data.frame(video.json$items)
  
  if (is.null(video.df)) {
    video.df <- curr.df
  } else {
    video.df <- bind_rows(video.df, curr.df)
  }
} 

video.df$contentDetails.videoId <- video.df$id
video_final.df <- merge(x = upload.df, 
                        y = video.df,
                        by = "contentDetails.videoId")
```

```{r, include=FALSE}

#finally doing something with that YouTube data

useful = video_final.df %>% select("snippet.title","statistics.viewCount","snippet.publishedAt", "statistics.commentCount") %>% mutate(statistics.viewCount = as.numeric(statistics.viewCount)) %>% mutate(snippet.publishedAt = as.numeric(substr(snippet.publishedAt, 12, 13))) %>% mutate(statistics.commentCount = as.numeric(statistics.commentCount))

useful2 = data.frame(
  Title = useful$snippet.title,
  Views = useful$statistics.viewCount,
  Hour_Published = useful$snippet.publishedAt,
  Comments = useful$statistics.commentCount
)

#top = useful2 %>% arrange(desc(Views)) %>% head(5)

#useful2 %>% group_by(snippet.publishedAt) %>% summarize(n())r
```

Average views per video (Your benchmarks!):

```{r, include=FALSE}
median = round(median(useful2$Views))
mean = round(mean(useful2$Views))
useful2$Views
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
paste("Median views: ", median)
paste("Mean views: ", mean)
```

 
How well each of your videos did, by which hour* of the day they were published (zoom + hover for precise info):
 
```{r, include = FALSE}
p = ggplot(useful2, aes(x = Hour_Published, y = Views, z = Title)) + geom_point(color="black", fill="red", shape=21, cex = 2) + labs(x = "Hour Published (UTC)", y = "Views on Each Video", title = "Views by Hour Published")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplotly(p)
```
*The default upload time is 00:00 in your local time. 00:00 EST is 04:00 UTC.
 
The median performance of a video posted at any given hour of the day (zoom + hover for precise info):
 
```{r, include=FALSE}
p = ggplot(useful2, aes(x = Hour_Published, y = Views)) + geom_bar(fill = "red", col = "black", stat = "summary", fun = "median") + labs(x = "Hour Published (UTC)", y = "Average Views Per Video", title = "Average Performance by Hour Published")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplotly(p)
```

How often you post videos at each hour (hover for precise info):
 
```{r, include=FALSE}
p = ggplot(useful2, aes(x = Hour_Published)) + geom_bar(fill = "red", col = "black") + labs(x = "Hour Published (UTC)", y = "Number of Videos Published", title = "Amount of Videos by Hour Published")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplotly(p)
```
 
Views and comments both boost engagement. How often do your videos do well in one or both categories? (Zoom + hover for precise info):
 
```{r, include = FALSE}
p = ggplot(useful2, aes(x = Comments, y = Views, z = Title)) + geom_point(color="black", fill="red", shape=21, cex = 2) + labs(x = "Number of Comments", y = "Views", title = "Number of Comments vs Views")
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggplotly(p)
```
